item.title: Rising Flu Activity Forces Schools and Workplaces to Adjust
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. (WDEF)— Rising flu cases are forcing Grundy County students to move to virtual learning this week. With schools and offices seeing increasing absences due to illness, several districts in the region are temporarily shifting to online instruction.
